scripts.build: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'), fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')){execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}}else{execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
